title: Thai-Style Steamed Fish
description: A delicate and flavorful Thai-inspired steamed fish dish, perfect for a light and healthy meal. The combination of Thai chili sauce, steamed fish, and fresh herbs creates a beautiful balance of flavors.
instructions: Rinse the fish under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
Season the fish with salt and pepper.
In a small saucepan, combine the Thai chili sauce, lime juice, and grated ginger.
Bring the mixture to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low and let it cook for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, prepare the steamer basket by placing a piece of parchment paper in the bottom.
Add the fish to the steamer basket and place it over boiling water.
Steam the fish for 8-10 minutes or until it's cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Remove the fish from the steamer and place it on a serving plate.
Drizzle the Thai chili sauce mixture over the fish.
Garnish with fresh Thai basil leaves and serve immediately.
